name: integrity
description: Tells implemented apart from verified: a requirement contract from your own words, a Mirage Detector for fake completeness, evidence from real test/build/lint runs, and an audit of completion claims.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Integrity hints: off, important (default) or all.

statusHint.title: Status hint
statusHint.description: Show the one-line integrity status under the prompt.

paneAutoOpen.title: Open pane automatically
paneAutoOpen.description: Open the Integrity pane at session start (only where it docks as a sidebar).

color.title: Color
color.description: Color status glyphs (glyphs always carry the meaning).

autoCapture.title: Capture task prompts
autoCapture.description: Draft a contract from implementation prompts when no task is active. Never approves it.

retentionDays.title: Retention (days)
retentionDays.description: Idle tasks older than this are deleted.

gitProvenance.title: Git provenance
gitProvenance.description: Record the git HEAD with each piece of evidence (runs git rev-parse, read-only).

aiAssist.title: AI requirement suggestions
aiAssist.description: Allow /integrity-suggest to make one model call per request. Off by default.
